name: Sleeping Goddess Style (Combat, Style)
body:
You can tap into your mind to refresh your body.

Prerequisites: Autohypnosis 3 ranks, one Sleeping Goddess stance known.

Benefit: You gain psionic focus as a standard action. When you do, you recover recover an expended maneuver as a free action. If you have the Psionic Meditation feat, you can instead gain psionic focus and recover an expended maneuver as a move action.
